title: Tenant lease preserver and incremental SLO backoff to avoid cascading evictions
author: Maya Chen
release_notes:
- Introduce tenant lease preserver that defers hard evictions during SLO backoff windows
- Add incremental backoff policy to reduce P99 regression risk
- Expose runtime flags for gradual rollout and safety thresholds
- Add observability for lease-preserve events and per-tenant backoff metrics
description:
Context: During a recent incident we observed cascade eviction behavior when the SLO enforcer moved tenants to hard-evict state aggressively under transient overloads (see SUP-987). This PR introduces a tenant lease preserver that temporarily converts hard-evict decisions into 'preserve-lease' windows and an incremental SLO backoff algorithm that lengthens backoff windows per tenant to avoid oscillation.

Motivation: prevent noisy evictions that amplify regional failover and reduce tail latency spiking when capacity flaps.

High level:
- Add tenant_lease_preserver component in serving/controlplane that records short-lived preserves and emits telemetry
- Change SLO enforcer decision path: hard-evict -> preserve-lease (short) -> escalate only if preserve window expires without improvement
- Introduce incremental backoff state machine that grows preserve windows with repeated infra failures and decays them on sustained healthy signals
- Expose rollout flags and percent-based gating via feature flags to allow staged enablement across regions

Description checklist:
- [x] Core algorithm and unit tests
- [x] Integration test exercising preserve -> escalate path
- [x] Metrics and tracing events added
- [x] Config flags + runtime documentation
- [x] Canary rollout plan in PR description

Changeset summary (commits): 1) 7c9f2a1 - feature: introduce tenant lease preserver state and store adapters 2) a4e11d3 - perf: move decision logic into lightweight hot path, reduce allocations 3) d5f8b24 - infra: add feature flags and rollout toggles 4) b3c2a99 - test: add integration harness for backoff scenarios 5) e8a7f00 - docs: operation docs and runbook notes Commits are squashed for merge; individual commits shown for reviewer context

Files/areas touched (high level):
- controlplane/slo/enforcer.go (decision flow changes, new preserve API)
- controlplane/slo/preserver.go (state machine, persistence interface)
- serving/router/eviction_agent.go (respect preserve windows on eviction)
- telemetry/metrics_registry.go (new slo.backoff_events, slo.lease_preserve_count)
- docs/runbooks/tenant-lease-preserver.md
- tests/integration/slo_preserve_test.go
- featureflags/config.yaml
- examples/canary-rollout.md

Small illustrative snippet (preserver window decay): "preserveWindow = min(maxWindow, preserveWindow * 2) on repeated failures; preserveWindow = max(baseWindow, preserveWindow / 2) on 5m healthy streak"

Observability and alerts:
- slo.backoff_events (counter with tenant_id tag)
- slo.lease_preserve_count (gauge for active preserves)
- telemetry emits trace span cross-service when a preserve is created and when it is escalated or released
- added docs with recommended dashboards and alerts: high preserve count per region -> investigate capacity/backpressure

Testing:
- unit tests for state transitions and decay logic
- integration test that simulates transient overload and verifies no immediate tenant eviction and eventual escalation after window expiry
- manual chaos test notes included in docs

Rollout plan:
1) Feature flag off by default
2) Enable for 5% tenants in us-west via flag
3) Monitor slo.backoff_events and p99 latency for 24h
4) Increase to 25% after no regressions
5) Full enable after 72h of healthy metrics

CI summary:
- linux/unit: pass
- linux/integration: pass
- lint: pass
- bench: pass (benchmarks show <1% overhead on hot path when disabled via flag)

Review conversation (selected):
- Arjun: "Can we guarantee the preserver won't starve eviction of malicious tenants?" Maya: "We keep an emergency override: preserve window cannot exceed 10s for tenants that exceed abuse thresholds; doc added."
- Sofia: "Prefer to move decay constants to config file for on-the-fly tuning." Maya: "Done; moved to featureflags/config.yaml and added runtime knobs."
- Tom: "Add end-to-end trace linking preserve->eviction for audit." Maya: "Added trace ids in telemetry and unit test asserting span names."

Hotfix considerations: This change aims to reduce blast radius; however it touches the eviction hot path so rollout is conservative. For urgent customer impact we also added a temporary safety bypass (featureflags.slo_preserver_bypass) to revert to previous behavior without code rollback.

Related work: ENG-6123 (design), SUP-987 (incident), PRs referenced during review: #2143577 (heartbeat sanitizer)

Backwards compatibility: configuration defaults preserve current behavior (preserver disabled) and is opt-in. Telemetry is additive.
